items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: Yeah, I played once or twice with him. But that was a regular band. Mm-hmm. Vic was a member of the band, you know?

ctx.x: He taught Vic Gaspar. He learned Vic Gaspar how to play. You know him?
Maybe Vic Gaspar went to the fellow that killed him.
